page.overview:
Who is Michael Bartels?

Michael Bartels is a retired Formula 1 driver, who competed for Lotus in four midseason races in 1991. He filled in for Johnny Herbert when the British driver had commitments in Japanese Formula 3000, failing to qualify for all the races he entered.
